regions.purpose: Identifies the surface and holds creation affordances in browse mode. In selection mode swaps to the selection action bar ({n} selected, Cancel, See on map).
The user's Collections, browsable as a vertical list. Rows render with a leading checkbox in selection mode.
A search field at the top of the content region. Filters the rendered list of Collections by name in-surface. Suppressed in selection mode.

affordances.label: Dismiss the sheet
affordances.rendering: The bottom-sheet's swipe-down or scrim-tap dismiss-gesture, not a dedicated button. Leaves any active `filter-context` on MapOverview untouched.

affordances.label: See on map
affordances.rendering: Primary action on the selection action bar. Disabled when zero rows are checked. On fire: sets MapOverview's `filter-context` to the selected ids (replacing any prior value), dismisses the sheet, and invokes MapOverview.jumpToCollection.

shows: Collection.appearance (color, pinStyle) as a visual marker
leading checkbox in selection mode (checked when the Collection's id is in the in-progress selection set, or in `filter-context.collectionIds` when the sheet was opened via TAP_FILTER_CHIP)

altAffordances.label: Long-press to select
altAffordances.rendering: Long-press gesture on any row. The long-pressed row starts checked; the sheet enters selection mode.

altAffordances.label: Toggle selection
altAffordances.rendering: Tap on a row in selection mode toggles its checkbox. Within-mode self-affordance — not a navigation transition.

lists.emptyState: When the user has no Collections, the content region shows a hint pointing at New Collection and Import a list.
